text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
One Sunday morning, with no particular plans for the day,
Chloe decides to look for a one-off job to earn a quick buck.
text_block_list.orig_text:
日曜の朝。
予定のないクロエは、
日払いの単発バイトを探していた。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: \"Delivery of goods, wage on request, all ages/genders accepted,\" huh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『配送業務の補助、
日給応談、
男女年齢問わず』
か……

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Might as well give this one a shot.
Lessee... contact details...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー……
よく分かんないけどコレでいっか。
えーと、
連絡先は……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
So you see, all we need you to do
is transport some letters and packages to the farm.
Your team leader will fill you in on the specifics.
text_block_list.orig_text:
というわけで、
手紙や荷物を牧場まで運んでもらうだけの
簡単な仕事だ。
詳しいことは
現場の者に直接聞いてほしい。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Roger that, chief.
text_block_list.orig_text: かしこまりでーす。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
You're assigned to Team F.
The leader will meet you at the start of the route,
so you can head straight there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
君の配置はF班だ。
班長を街道で待たせておくから、
さっそく向かってくれ。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: By the way, do you have any battle experience?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちなみに君、
戦闘経験はあるかね？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Eh?
I dunno what kinda \"way\" that's \"by,\" but sure.
I grew up in a kinda rowdy neighborhood, so I can handle myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハ？
いや、何にちなんだのか謎っすけど、
まあ。
ほんのり物騒な環境で育ってきたんで、
それなりには。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good! Then I'm sure you'll be just fine.
You see, on the route—right about here on the map—
there have been some monster sightings.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか、
だったら万一のときも大丈夫だな。
いや、
実は道中──
地図でいうとこの辺りなんだが、
魔物の目撃報告があってね。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Huh... News to me.
There's monsters 'round those parts?
text_block_list.orig_text:
へー、
初知り。
そんなん出るんだ、
あそこ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Took my kid brothers there for a picnic not that long ago,
and it seemed like a quiet enough forest to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
前にピクニックとかゆって
弟たち連れてったことあるけど、
のどかな森って印象しかなかったなー

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it would.
The monster warning was only issued a few days back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だろうね。
気を付けろって勧告が出たのは、
ほんの数日前さ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Warning, huh.
text_block_list.orig_text: 勧告。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, it's just a lone monster, separated from its pack.
At any rate, Nightmare sent a team to deal with it,
but weren't even able to locate the beast.
text_block_list.orig_text:
と言っても、
群れからはぐれたのが
一匹うろついてるだけだ。
なにしろ、
騎士団がすぐ討伐に向かったらしいが、
発見することすらできなかったという話だからな。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
So I'd imagine the odds of meeting it are very low indeed.
Unless you're very unlucky, you shouldn't have any trouble at all.
No need to dwell on it too much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
逆に言えば、
そいつに出くわすのは
その程度の確率だ。
よほどツイてない限り、
何事も起こらず
終わるだろう。
あまり深くは考えなくていい。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is that right.
Well, not like it makes much difference...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ、
そーすか……
まあ、いいけど知らんし何でも……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh, one more thing.
About your team leader...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
それと。
君の班の班長についてだが──

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
He may seem... rough around the edges,
but he's a hard worker and a good person all around.
Please take good care of him. I'm counting on you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──若干の粗相はあるかもしれないが、
仕事は真面目だし
人間として
いいやつだ。
しっかり
面倒見てやってくれ。
頼んだぞ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Do what now?
Isn't that backwards?
Why've I gotta... Am I his babysitter?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ？
　どゆこと？
え、逆じゃなくて？
うちが面倒……
え、
引率？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha!
text_block_list.orig_text: はっはっはっ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Think it's funny, do ya.
No, for real though, the heck is this about?
What's the deal with this team leader.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに笑ろてんねん。
いや、分かんない分かんない、さっぱり分かんない。
いったい何モンなんすか、その班長。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... This guy... It all makes sense now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
そゆことかー
班長コレかー

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
But, uh, again?
You're here [i]again?[/i] 
What is this, fate?
text_block_list.orig_text:
てか、またかよ。
またあんたかよ。
もはや運命かよ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
And some \"team\" this is. It's just one guy.
Even with me that's like, two.
Just the good ol' Lost Boy and Part-Timer duo.
choice_data_list: I'm not going to get lost today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかも「班」とか言って、
構成員一名じゃん。
うちが入ってギリ二名じゃん。
ただの毎度おなじみ迷子＆店員ズじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
I'd hope not. If their delivery guys couldn't find addresses,
some postal service that'd be. All of Landosol'd be in trouble.
text_block_list.orig_text:
当たり前。
迷い癖あるやつに配達員させてたら、
我が国の郵便システム問題あるわ。
ランドソル全土に震撼が走るわ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Hang on... Wait a minute.
Don't tell me all those times you got lost, you were on delivery jobs...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、いや……
ちょ待って……
まさか、
いつもあんたが迷ってるのって、
配送業務中じゃ……

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
No, don't tell me. I don't wanna know.
I'd rather not learn any deep-seated societal issues.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
やっぱいい。
聞かないどこ。
うちの手に余る深刻な社会問題が浮上しかねない。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Uhh, on to the job, then.
I'm Chloe, your part-time helper for today. Pleasure and stuff.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー、
そんじゃ切り換えー
本日ヘルプで入った臨時バイトのクロエっす。
シクヨロ～

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Gotta say, this role reversal is really kinda throwing me off...
Don't you get that too?
choice_data_list: I'm happy we can work together!
I'm sad that we're working together...
text_block_list.orig_text:
つってコレ、
いつもと立場逆だからなんか調子狂うな……
{0}もそう思わん？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: What are you, five?
text_block_list.orig_text: 無邪気か。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess... that's fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まァ、べつに……
いいけど。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: ...What?
text_block_list.orig_text: あァ？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Oops, silly me.
Looks like I \"accidentally\" drew my dagger.
Almost slipped 'round your back and pressed it to your neck.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーっと、
ごめ。
今イラッと来て無意識に短剣抜いちゃった。
なんなら背後に回りこんで喉元突きつけそうになっちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I've got it wrong? It's 'cause of the monster warning?
Oh... you were worried about me?
Then say so, why don'tcha... Well, whatever.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　そうじゃなくて？
　魔物に遇うかもしれないから？
ああ、
うちの身が心配ってこと？
言葉ハショり過ぎでしょ……
まあ、
いいけど。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's get moving.
Uh, this is the stuff to deliver, right?
...Heave-ho.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんじゃ、
とりま行こかー
えっと、
牧場に運ぶ荷物ってコレだよね？
──っしょっと。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm good.
I'm getting paid for this. And you're the guy in charge, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
いいって。
こっちだって仕事だし、
そっちは一応班長なんだから。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Oh, you sure?
Well... I guess, if you're gonna be that insistent...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
あ、
そーお？
うん……
じゃあ、
そこまで言うなら任せるけど……

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: The heck... When he's on the job, he's actually kinda cool...
text_block_list.orig_text:
何あいつ……
仕事中だと、
ちょっと頼もしげじゃん……

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Huh... Who'd've thought.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふうん……
生意気。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Yep, I take it back.
He's still hopeless.
Mr. Team Leader's gotten us lost already.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハイ、前言撤かーい。
頼もしみゼロー
この班長、
さっそく道に迷ってまーす。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Uh, sure you're not.
I mean, look, on the map they gave me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやウソじゃん。
だって、確か、
うちがもらった地図だと──

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
...There, you see?
We're well off the course we were supposed to take.
choice_data_list: I thought I heard a voice over this way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ほら、やっぱ。
もう規定コースからヨユーで外れてるじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Excuses!
text_block_list.orig_text: 必死。（笑）

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Like, are you for real? Voices?
What's that even supposed to—
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、何その言い訳、
超イミフ。
声がしたって、
何の──

text_block_list.name: Girl's Voice
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃあああああ！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
...!
Someone's under attack?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ッ！
誰か襲われてる！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text: N-nooooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いやああぁぁ！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text: Aaaahh! S-stay back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひぃぃ、
来ないでぇー！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Those idiots...!
What're they doing here when there's a monster warning?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子ら……！
注意勧告が出てるのに、
こんなとこで何を──

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Well, uh. They're classmates.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
まあ、
同級生。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Damn right.
I'll dash in and distract the monster,
so you get the girls to safety while I—
text_block_list.orig_text:
トーゼン。
うちが突っこんで魔物を引きつけるから、
{0}はその間にあの子たちを──

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Wha—?!
Wait... What the? My body feels super light...
Huh? This is your magic...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハ！？
ちょ……
何コレ、
身体がめっちゃ軽くなって……
えっ？
　あんたの魔法……？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. Talk can wait!
With this, it'll be over in no time... Hahh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあいいや、
話はあと！
これならソッコー終わるし……
ふッ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRUAAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Pff...
Shut up now, monster. You're way too loud.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷー……
うるさいよ、
化け物。
はしゃぎ過ぎ。

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text: A-aaahhh...? Chloe...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あああ……？
　クロエさん……？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
See?
You're making my friends scared.
So it's time for you to quiet down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら。
うちの友達、
恐がってるから。
ちょっと静かにしててくんない。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRUOOOGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Whew... It's safe now.
You guys OK?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷふー……
もう大丈夫。
怪我なかった？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text: Y-y-yes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はい……

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
You can quit shaking now.
It's fine. I kicked that monster's dumb ass.
Here, can you stand?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつまでブルッてんの。
平気だって、
魔物ならもう完全ボコにしたから。
ほら、
立てる？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひいぃっ！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ohhh, I see.
Guess you're more scared of me right now than the monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
あー、
そっか。
魔物ってか、
魔物を軽くブチのめしちゃったうちのが恐いか。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Well... figures. I don't mind.
Anyway, glad you're OK at least.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、だよね。
いいけど。
とにかく、
そっちが無事でよかったし。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: C'mon, your parents'll be worried. Hurry on home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
親とか心配してるから、
早よ帰ったりー

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text: U-um, ahhh... How to say this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの、
その……
なんと申しますか……

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text: G-good day to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご、
ごきげんよう！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Polite to a fault, huh.
text_block_list.orig_text: 礼儀正しいかよ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
But yeah.
They're true sheltered little ladies.
This whole thing must've been a real shock. Poor girls.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーね。
あんなカンジの箱入りお嬢サマじゃね。
こんな体験、
よっぽど恐かったんでしょ。
かあいそーに。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
Still, uh... Like, for real?
Did I really look that scary back there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
でも……
うち、
そんな？
そんな鬼気迫る恐ろし系の形相してた？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Oh? Well, thanks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
よかった。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look, you weren't half bad yourself.
You can be pretty cool when you try, I guess.
text_block_list.orig_text:
てか、
まあ、
ソレ言うなら{0}もね。
カッコよかったんじゃないの、
知んないけど。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
But, uh...
It's just that... I dunno, like...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
まあ……
なんかさ？
　
なんてゆーか？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text:
It's kinda depressing that they didn't even thank me,
but it makes me feel like a real hero, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
礼すら言ってもらえなかったのはちょっと寂しいけど、
逆にソレも正義の味方っぽくてエモだよね。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Booyah.
text_block_list.orig_text: うぇーい。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Chloe and {0} bumped fists to celebrate their victory,
and went on to complete their delivery to the farm without issue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝利の拳を突き合わせるクロエと{0}。
二人はその後、牧場への配達仕事も無事に成し遂げるのだった。
